LESSON: INDUSTRY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: GEOGRAPHY FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Human and Economic Activities
Topic 3.4: Industry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Industry, part of Human and Economic Activities in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 GEOGRAPHY FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why is industrialization important in Kenya?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Industry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: The skill of open-mindedness is enhanced as the learner writes a request and

models a cottage industry in the school.

● Creativity and Imagination: The skill of making connections is developed as the learner carries out a field study on effects

of industries on environment.

Values:
● Social Justice: Learner has freedom as they develop communication messages on consumer concerns about development of

industries.

● Patriotism: Learner exhibits culture awareness as they write a request for establishing a cottage industry and models the

industry in the school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial Literacy: Learner writes a request for establishing a cottage industry and model the industry in the school.

● Consumer Education: Learner develops communication messages on consumer concerns on development of industries.

Suggested Learning Resources

Photographs, Pictures, Local and extended environment, Realia, Digital devices with assistive technology, Charts and marker

pens, Approved textbooks and other printed or braille resources, Whiteboards and marker pens, Clay and Plasticine, sisal

fibre, Hides and skins, wood, stone.

Suggested Key Skills

• Exploring the types of agriculture in the world.

• Explaining the importance of agriculture in the society.

• Describing the methods used in extraction of minerals in the world.

43

• Exploring the mining of limestone in Kenya diamond in Botswana and iron ore in Australia.

• Examining the types and sources of energy for domestic and industrial use.

• Exploring the types of industries in the world.
